day_focus: Balance the drive for ministry outreach with a steady, present heart for Maria and the kids.
checkin: It's Throwback Thursday, son; take a moment to look back at how far the Lord has brought us without letting yesterday's wins or losses steal today's peace. Reach out to the brothers and the ministry, but remember that your first and finest mission is right here under your own roof. Keep your eyes on the prize, but keep your heart in the room.
